description:
FILED s522a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-19) from the #3061 acceptance runs: Text-CSV-2.04's t/util.pl transpiles now, and 15 t/ files run rows they never ran.  Every row below was checked against TWO emulations under real perl 5.40.3 (scratch/s522a/fu/run.sh: utf8::is_utf8 forced to 1 = #1389; fu/run2.sh: that PLUS Text::CSV_PP's `%{$self->{_CACHE}} = %$ctx` stores removed = #3611) and is NOT reproduced by either -- so it is a different mechanism.  Outputs: scratch/s522a/csv/<file>.out in the s522a worktree.

SILENT WRONG rows, cause NOT isolated.  t/51_utf8.t rows 4 5 7 10 11 13 16 17 22 23 28 29 ("Unicode <layer> against Perl/expected"), 47 53 59 77 83 89 ("bytes dn/up <layer> against expected"), 129 132 135 139 151 154 157 161 173 176 179 183 (output / data from getline ()), and t/50_utf8.t row 64 "First field is binary" fail in PCL; real perl with both emulations passes them (the other 28 51_utf8 rows ARE #1389/#3611).  The rows compare a CSV round-trip through `:utf8` / `:encoding(UTF-8)` / binmode layers against perl's own split.  Related: #1389, #3515 (layer spelling).  NEXT STEP: minimise one "Unicode :utf8 against Perl" row.

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- one-file board runs (`tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows cpan-tests/modules/Text-CSV-2.04 t/51_utf8.t`, `t/50_utf8.t`, through
  heavy.sh HEAVY_BOUNDED=1; scratch/s543c/legs/rows.log):
  51_utf8.t: pass=131 fail=58 of 207 planned, then the file dies "INI - SEP too long" (SBCL rc 255).  The rows keyed here still fail: 4 5 7
    10 11 13 16 17 22 23 28 29 (got '20ac', expected '22 20ac 22' -- the quotes are lost), 47 53 59 77 83 89 (got '22 e2 82 ac 22', expected
    the doubly encoded '22 c3 a2 c2 82 c2 ac 22'), and the 129-183 output / fields / getline rows.  Rows 139 and 161 print
    `"N{EURO SIGN}"` -- the test's `\N{EURO SIGN}` escape left as text, i.e. #1494 is one of the causes behind this file.
  50_utf8.t: pass=89 fail=4 -- rows 64 ('First field is binary' got 0, expected 1), 71 ('String 0-1' got ' ,1,€ ', expected ' ,1,"€ "' --
    the quoting of a field with a wide character), 85 and 93 ('not utf8').
LABEL: silent (subject rewritten).  The cause remains NOT isolated, as filed; the next measurement is the same emulation run with `\N{...}`
  spelled as `\x{...}` in a copy of the test, which would separate #1494's rows from the rest.
subject: SILENT WRONG: Text-CSV 51_utf8.t (the encoding-layer / binary-field rows) + 50_utf8.t rows 64 / 71 fail where perl passes -- not #1389, not #3611; one visible sub-cause is #1494 (`\N{EURO SIGN}` printed literally); the file now dies "INI - SEP too long" at row ~190
